unit.why: A single anecdote about an unnamed rabbinic gaon of the previous generation who freed an agunah and exposed a forged letter; taken from Mishivat Nefesh, with no Hasidic figure.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מעשה על רב גאון אחד
stories.end_quote: צא ולמד כמה גדול כח התורה
stories.summary_en: A gaon permits an agunah to remarry. An enemy forges a letter from her 'living' first husband, and the rabbi at once sees through it. He explains that a ruling reached by pure Torah toil cannot lead to sin: even had the husband been alive, he would have died at the hour of the ruling.
